settings.heading: Which transport operations can the program support?
settings.text: Programs can be shaped for road freight, passenger transport, rail, aviation, maritime, warehousing and multi-modal logistics operations.

settings.heading: Can one program cover multiple depots and jurisdictions?
settings.text: Yes. Andatech can standardise equipment, training, calibration and reporting across locations while the workplace policy accounts for the relevant duties, transport mode and jurisdiction.

settings.heading: When should transport workers be tested?
settings.text: Your policy should define approved triggers such as pre-employment, random, scheduled, for-cause and post-incident testing. The appropriate triggers depend on your risks, legal duties and consultation process.

settings.heading: What happens after a non-negative screening result?
settings.text: A non-negative screen is not treated as a confirmed positive. Follow the workplace procedure, chain-of-custody requirements and accredited laboratory confirmation pathway where required.
